claims.text: Grimbeorn became a great lord in his own right. Like his father, he was the chieftain of the Beornings and he dwelt in the same regions of the Vales of Anduin. During his time, the High Pass and the Ford of Carrock were kept open and no Orc or Warg dared to enter his land.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "Many Meetings"
